metadata.title: DattoRMM.Core
metadata.description: PowerShell module for the Datto RMM API v2. Provides typed, object-oriented access to devices, sites, alerts, jobs, components, filters, and variables with built-in adaptive throttling, secure credential handling, and CSV export support. Requires PowerShell 7.4+.
